name: agentic-coding-kit
description: Generic, project-agnostic skills and tools for AI-assisted software development for Claude Code and Kilo Code

plugins.name: common-tools
plugins.description: Common Utilities Suite - Cross-platform development tools for Claude & Kilo (gitignore, markdown-formatter, macroplan-authoring, merge-resolver)

plugins.name: agent-tooling-meta
plugins.description: Kilo/Claude ecosystem meta-tooling - manage, sync, author and migrate Kilo Code and Claude Code's own configuration (plugin installs, skill/agent authoring, cross-tool sync, Roocode migration, generating a grounded reference skillset for a framework/library from its source/docs/spec via /generate-skillset). Not about delegating work - see ai-architect-executor/kilo-mcp for that.

plugins.name: third-party-skills
plugins.description: Bundled Third-Party Suite - Curated external skills (Anthropic, RooCode, Community)

plugins.name: angular-dev-kit
plugins.description: Angular v20+ Development Suite - own skills for authoring publishable libraries (angular-library) and for Lucide icons (angular-icons-lucide), plus 10 vendored application-side references (component, di, directives, forms, http, routing, signals, ssr, testing, tooling) from analogjs/angular-skills (MIT, Brandon Roberts) - see plugin README for which is which
